view.scene_description: A blurry interior shot of a brightly lit supermarket aisle. Shelves on both sides are stocked with colorful packaged goods. Decorative hot air balloon ornaments hang from the ceiling. A person walks down the center aisle toward a refrigerated section in the background. The image has motion blur, suggesting movement during capture.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person is walking down the aisle, seen from behind. They wear a dark top and light pants, carrying a bag over their shoulder. Their position is central, moving away from the camera toward the refrigerated section. Blurred due to motion.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Metal shelves line both sides of the aisle, filled with various products in colorful packaging. Some items are in wire baskets. The shelves extend into the distance, converging toward the back of the store. Products are densely packed.

objects.label: hot air balloon decorations
objects.observation: Several decorative hot air balloons hang from the ceiling above the aisle. They are colorful and appear to be made of fabric or paper. One green-and-white balloon is near the top left, another pink-and-white is centered, and a yellow one is near the top right.

objects.label: refrigerated section
objects.observation: A glass-fronted refrigerated display case is visible at the end of the aisle, located behind the person. It contains various items, likely beverages or dairy products. A red promotional sign is mounted above it.

objects.label: promotional sign
objects.observation: A red rectangular sign with white Chinese characters is mounted above the refrigerated section. The text reads '畅爽美味 要可口可乐' (translated: 'Refreshing taste, choose Coca-Cola'). It is positioned centrally above the fridge.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000023", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
